name: matrix-hud-live-edit
description: M19 F1 acceptance: on matrix (now genuinely edit-capable) the Task HUD posts ONE breadcrumb chip at the first tool call and edits it in place on every later frame — one message edited, never re-posted. The harness models matrix's real edit-in-place deliver_breadcrumb via model_rich_breadcrumbs; the replay.rs test asserts exactly one breadcrumb post and >=1 edit, all targeting that single anchor. See README.md.
